items.criterion: Exactly one lead row exists after simultaneous submissions carrying one idempotency key.
items.judgment: Fire simultaneous submissions under one key and count the stored leads.

items.criterion: The catalogue total, the four facet counts and the card list describe one instant.
items.judgment: Read the unfiltered catalogue and compare the total against the length of the result set.

items.criterion: The four discipline counts sum above the total, because a project carries several disciplines.
items.judgment: Sum the facet counts and compare against the total.

items.criterion: A superseded path answers with a permanent redirect straight to the address the record occupies now.
items.judgment: Rename a published slug and request the old path without following redirects.

items.criterion: An acknowledgement reaches the mail server for every lead that exists.
items.judgment: Submit an enquiry and read the inbox for the pinned subject.

items.criterion: The preflight names every unmet obligation rather than the first.
items.judgment: Run the preflight on the seeded incomplete draft and count the findings.

items.criterion: Publishing one project moves the public total by one and each carried discipline by one.
items.judgment: Read the catalogue, publish a complete project, and read the catalogue again.

items.criterion: An editor reaching a lead is refused with the status an absent record carries.
items.judgment: Request the lead inbox with an editor token and read the status.

items.criterion: A candidate document is unreachable until its scan returns clean.
items.judgment: Request a document still in the pending scan state and read the status.

items.criterion: An activity entry accepts no update and no delete.
items.judgment: Attempt an update and a delete against a stored entry and read both statuses.

items.criterion: A lead stores the wording of each question as it was asked at submission.
items.judgment: Submit an enquiry, then read the lead detail for the submitted question wording.

items.criterion: A withdrawal issues a certificate naming every store the record was removed from.
items.judgment: Withdraw a lead by its token and read the returned certificate.

items.criterion: Every public route carries a title and a description no other route shares.
items.judgment: Walk every public route and compare the declared titles and descriptions.

items.criterion: The site answers French without a prefix and English under its own prefix.
items.judgment: Request the French and the English catalogue addresses and read both statuses.
